name: Forum
notes: Seat of the governor and the town council. Already there at the start; cannot be built twice.

name: Residential district
notes: DRAFT. Each district houses 1,500 people; the town cannot grow beyond its houses.

name: Harbour
notes: DRAFT. Each harbour has berths for 3 ships. Convoys need a ship; the shipyard builds them.

name: Walls and towers
notes: DRAFT. The town walls; a second ring of towers can be added. +2 to defence rolls each.

name: Workshop
notes: DRAFT. Smithy, potters or weavers: +6 goods every season.

name: Market
notes: DRAFT. Stall fees +100 denarii a season, and convoys trade 10% better.

name: Temple
notes: DRAFT. +1 loyalty and +1 Roman favour every season; the haruspex has a proper home.

name: Barracks
notes: DRAFT. Soldiers cost 1 denarius less each season, and +1 to battle rolls.

name: Baths
notes: DRAFT. Roman comfort: +2 loyalty every season.

name: Wheat terraces
notes: DRAFT. Each terrace gives a quarter of the base harvest (the 4 at the start give the 8 months a year in seasons.csv). Wind changes the yield.

name: Vineyards and olive groves
notes: DRAFT. +4 amphorae of wine and oil every season once mature (8 seasons), twice that in Autumn.

name: Fishery
notes: DRAFT. +0.5 months of grain every season, winter too; wind does not matter. Only 3 places on the shore.
